User.title: User
User.description: User account profile for authenticated forensics examiners.

id.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

photoURL.description: Avatar photo URL of the user.

role.description: Role determining access to admin features.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user registered.

Prediction.title: Prediction
Prediction.description: Signature analysis record containing specimen forensics, prediction, and SHAP explainability attributions.

userId.description: Auth UID of the examiner who performed the analysis.

label.description: User-assigned label or specimen description (e.g. Contract Page 3, Cheque #102).

modelUsed.description: Name and version of the ML model.

predictionTimeMs.description: Inference and feature extraction latency in ms.

features.description: Extracted stroke and spatial moments features.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the analysis was performed.

Signer.title: Signer
Signer.description: Enrolled reference signature card for writer-dependent verification.

id.description: Unique identifier of the signer card.

name.description: Full name of the enrolled signer.

registeredBy.description: Email or UID of examiner who enrolled the signer.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles with role-based permissions.

/predictions/{predictionId}.description: Stores signature verification analysis and audit records.

/signers/{signerId}.description: Stores enrolled signer reference cards for writer-dependent verification.
